bagPolicy.summary: At Reds games, bags may not exceed 16" x 16" x 8". Backpacks are not allowed unless designed for medical or infant care.
allowed: Soft sided coolers with food or sealed non alcoholic drinks
prohibited: Backpacks (multi pocketed bags worn on the back)
bagPolicy.note: This is the posted policy for Reds games. The ballpark says other events may have different policies, so check your concert's event page. Medical and infant care backpacks are allowed.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Great American Ball Park can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Great American Ball Park's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Great American Ball Park offers a diverse range of food options, including traditional ballpark fare, local Cincinnati favorites, and new creations by Chef Gary Davis. Highlights include the Redlegs BBQ Walking Taco and the 50 West Soft Pretzel Double Cheeseburger, available for a limited time. Fans can also enjoy specialty cocktails, a premium selection of bourbons, and a variety of ice cream treats.
stands: Suite Bridge Ice Cream & Suite Bridge Bar

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All Suites are ADA accessible and have 2 removable seats at the top row of seating for wheelchairs/scooters. Accessible parking is available in the East section of the Central Riverfront Garage (formerly called the Great American Ball Park Parking Garage) for $27 and in the East Garage for $16.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Limited re-entry is permitted at Great American Ball Park. Guests are subject to metal detection screening upon re-entry and there will be no carry-in items permitted through the re-entry gate.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office at the main Crosley Terrace entrance (corner of Second Street and Joe Nuxhall Way) will be open for purchasing tickets and Will Call, along with any digital ticketing questions you may have Will Call: Reds tickets left for will call and drop-offs may be picked up at the “paid” will call windows located at the Main Ticket Office at Crosley Terrace.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Guests inside of the ballpark can use the re-entry gate at the Gapper’s Alley gates to gain access to the smoking area. Guests are subject to metal detection screening upon re-entry and there will be no carry-in items permitted through the re-entry gate.
